frozen_fields.exclusion_rule: No outcome-based exclusion. Exclude only documented specimen breakage/loss, instrument failure affecting the planned measurement, or a protocol deviation recorded before blind-code decoding; every exclusion and reason remains published.

execution_rule: no confirmatory measurement file may exist before all frozen_fields are non-null, status=frozen_ready_for_registration, and the package is publicly registered before acquisition
scientific_rule_inherited: A = 1 - abs(delta_R_apres)/abs(delta_R_avant); success requires delta_R_avant nonzero, A >= 0.50 and preregistered bilateral interaction p <= 0.05
sham_role: paired negative control included in the interaction and reported separately; no additional post-hoc threshold may be invented

candidate_lab.name: Fort Hoofddijk Paleomagnetic Laboratory, Utrecht University

remaining_lab_freeze_strategy: Use a non-confirmatory sacrificial-sample pilot to set AF plateau, test field and temperature window; generate and retain the blind-code key off-repository, committing only its SHA-256 before registration.
